skill.name: humanizer
skill.description: Edits AI-sounding drafts into natural prose by detecting common patterns such as inflated claims, vague attribution, formulaic structure, overused AI vocabulary, em dash overuse, and filler.
skill.summary: Rewrite AI-sounding text into clearer, more natural prose.

content.user_title: Humanize AI Drafts With Natural Editing
content.value_statement: AI drafts often sound polished but generic. This skill finds common AI writing patterns and rewrites text with clearer, more natural wording.
actual_capabilities: Detects 24 AI writing patterns listed in the skill guide.
Rewrites inflated or promotional phrasing into direct prose.
Replaces vague attributions with specific wording when details are present.
Reduces formulaic structures such as rule-of-three lists and generic conclusions.
Cleans style artifacts such as em dash overuse, boldface overuse, emojis, and curly quotes.
Can provide a brief summary of the changes made.
limitations: Does not verify facts, citations, or claims in the source text.
Cannot guarantee that text will pass AI detection tools.
May change tone if the audience or voice is not specified.
Needs human review for academic, legal, medical, or regulated writing.

use_cases.title: Clean product updates
use_cases.description: Turn polished but vague launch notes into direct customer-facing copy with concrete details.

use_cases.title: Improve technical drafts
use_cases.description: Remove filler, generic transitions, and inflated claims from documentation or engineering updates.

use_cases.title: Edit personal essays
use_cases.description: Add a more natural voice while keeping the writer's main point and intended tone.

prompt_templates.title: Basic humanize pass
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner rewrite for a short draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Humanize this text. Keep the meaning the same and remove obvious AI writing patterns: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Match a target tone
prompt_templates.prompt: Humanize this draft for [audience]. Use a [tone] tone. Keep facts unchanged and summarize the main edits: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Clean a professional update
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this update so it sounds direct and natural. Remove filler, vague attributions, and promotional language: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Advanced pattern audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Identify the AI writing patterns in this draft, rewrite the text, and list only the most important changes: [paste text].

output_examples.input: The update serves as a testament to our commitment to innovation, offering a seamless, intuitive, and powerful experience.
output_examples.output: The update adds batch actions, keyboard shortcuts, and a cleaner settings page. These changes help users finish common tasks faster.

output_examples.input: Despite several challenges, the team continues to thrive and shape the evolving landscape of customer support.
output_examples.output: The team reduced average response time from 12 hours to 5 hours after adding weekend coverage and a new triage process.

output_examples.input: Great question! This article delves into the intricate interplay between strategy, execution, and innovation.
output_examples.output: This article explains how the team chose a strategy, tested it, and changed course when early results were weak.

best_practices: Provide the audience, tone, and purpose before asking for a rewrite.
Check every factual claim after the rewrite, especially dates, sources, and metrics.
Review the final text aloud to confirm it still sounds like the intended writer.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to hide AI authorship where disclosure is required.
Do not ask it to invent sources, quotes, metrics, or personal experience.
Do not accept every rewrite without checking meaning, tone, and factual accuracy.

faq.question: What does this skill change?
faq.answer: It rewrites AI-sounding phrases, filler, vague claims, and formulaic structures into clearer prose.

faq.question: Does it detect all AI-written text?
faq.answer: No. It looks for common patterns from the guide, but it is not a reliable AI detector.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Will it preserve my facts?
faq.answer: It is designed to preserve meaning, but users should verify facts, citations, and numbers after editing.

faq.question: What text works best?
faq.answer: Drafts with clear facts, a known audience, and a stated tone usually produce the best results.

faq.question: Is it safe for academic or regulated writing?
faq.answer: Use it only when editing is allowed and disclosure rules are followed. Human review is still required.
